_comment: Marsmap settings, read at Play (also inside headset builds). server_url: Python/server.py's address; on a headset use the laptop's Wi-Fi IP, e.g. ws://192.168.1.23:8765, and start the server with --host 0.0.0.0. mode: auto = server if it answers within offline_after_s seconds, else the offline bundle in StreamingAssets/Marsmap; server = always the server; offline = never connect, use the bundle. offline_auto_start_s: 0 = start the EVA replay with X / Enter; otherwise start automatically this many seconds after the terrain loads. vr_*: comfort settings used only in a headset (desktop movement is unchanged). See docs/VR_QUEST.md.
